item.title: Helix Charter girls' water polo claims first D1 CIF title
item.description: The Helix Charter girls' water polo team celebrated their first-ever D1 CIF section title on "Good Morning San Diego."

item.title: Target will stop selling cereals with synthetic colors by end of May
item.description: Target will stop selling cereals containing synthetic colors by the end of May. The Minneapolis-based discounter said Friday it had been phasing out synthetic colors in cereals for several years. item.title: Two school buses collide near Lafayette Elementary School
item.description: Two school busses collided near Lafayette Elementary School in Clairemont on Friday morning, resulting in no injuries to passengers.

item.title: Everything to know about the The Flower Fields at Carlsbad Ranch
item.description: The Flower Fields at Carlsbad Ranch is set to open for the 2026 season on March 1, featuring 80 million blooms in 13 vibrant shades, along with a rotating lineup of weekly pop-up shops, an enhanced Butterfly Encounter experience, and a variety of performances, activities, and attractions.

item.title: Suspect in Pacific Beach homicide case extradited to San Diego
item.description: Felipe Villegas, 27, was extradited from Texas to San Diego County on Friday to face charges in connection with the 2022 killing of 65-year-old Mary Garcia in Pacific Beach.

item.title: Southbound lanes of I-5 in La Jolla closing overnight for bridge repairs
item.description: SAN DIEGO (FOX 5/KUSI) -- A majority of southbound lanes on Interstate 5 will be closed Friday and Saturday evening to allow Caltrans to conduct bridge work. item.title: EPA leader visits Valley Center avocado farm, also discuss Tijuana sewage
item.description: EPA Administrator Lee Zeldin visited a farm in Valley Center to discuss the plight of the California avocado industry and the Tijuana sewage crisis, and pledged to prioritize California growers and work to fix the cross-boundary sewage flow.

item.title: Former East County principal sues Dehesa School District, alleging whistleblower retaliation
item.description: DEHESA, Calif. (FOX 5/KUSI) — A former East County school principal has filed a lawsuit against the Dehesa School District, alleging she was fired in retaliation for reporting safety violations and concerns about student attendance records tied to state funding. item.title: 'He didn't deserve it': Family pleads for justice in fatal North County crash
item.description: A 62-year-old North County man was struck and killed by a hit-and-run driver in San Marcos on Feb. 21, and his family is urging witnesses to come forward as detectives continue to investigate.

item.title: 11-year-old seriously injured after crashing e-motorcycle in Scripps Ranch
item.description: An 11-year-old child was seriously injured after crashing an electric motorcycle at Jerabek Park in Scripps Ranch, and the incident is still under investigation.
